observations.behavior: Adds swept_through to FindScannerCandidatesOutput and refresh_scanner_estimate activity, and uses it to advance watermark without dispatching child activities. P1.F14.H2 also adds a retry policy and schedule_to_close_timeout, and P1.F12.H2 adds a stale connection closer.
observations.posthog_connection: Replay Vision scanner sweep workflow: advances watermark to the settle horizon when no candidates are found, allowing the workflow to continue without dispatching child recording activities, while also adding a retry policy and schedule_to_close_timeout to avoid burning workflow budget on slow ClickHouse admissions.
